title: A semi-fork gets its own waiting page and record branch
why: shiv, Oct 31 15:00 CDT, chat with triage: option a. Asked how a worktree whose work never reaches main (a semi-fork) works with the artifacts. Risk read from the code: a worktree keeps the repo's waiting-page key in .claude/layout-extras.json, so fork and main share one page, one database and two writers, and the record branch roadmap is shared too.
